name: 覃鑫富
objective: Study the state of the art of the IC fabrication processes, including heating, ion implant, PVD, CVD, lithograph, etching of the front-end processes and packaging and testing of back-end processes. The trends of the processes, the relationship of the processes with the physics of the devices and the process integrating technology will also be taught in this course. The fundamentals for advanced semiconductor packaging will be provided.
schedule: The teacher expects each chapter to be finished weekly, but the schedule is flexible.
scorePolicy:
Midterm: 25%
Class Attendance: 20%
Term paper, Journal paper critique (2): 30%
Final: 25%
materials: K. N. Tu, Hung-Ming Chen, Chih Chen. Electronic Packaging, Science and Engineering, Wiley 2021.
consultation: Students might have access to curricular consultation from the advisor to get advice about courses or academic planning.
